findings.evidence: The only inhabitant of `SpectatorPartners` in the repo is `spectatorPartners_kFour` (ParityOdd.lean:509), built as `spectatorPlaneFour.spectatorPartners gFour_isSymm …`; under a `SpectatorPlane` the `_of_spectatorPlane` versions prove the same four statements with no non-nullity hypothesis. Its single consumer, `not_isLorentzCovariant_aFour` (515-518), uses only `.toSpectatorSplitting` and `.self_ne_zero_of_spectator`, both already available as `SpectatorPlane.toSpectatorSplitting` (Basic.lean:1165) and `gFour_self_ne_zero_of_spectator` (ParityOdd.lean:489). The existing 3-dimensional witness `gWit`/`kWit` has a one-dimensional spectator line, so it cannot inhabit `SpectatorPartners` either. The four `_right` variants are additionally one-line `hW.isAlt.isRefl.eq_zero …` wrappers with no call site in the repo.
findings.fix: Delete the `SpectatorPartners` structure, its accessor, `SpectatorPlane.spectatorPartners`, `SpectatorPair.apply_smul_add_smul`, `spectatorPartners_kFour` and the four partner-hypothesis lemmas; keep the four `_of_spectatorPlane` lemmas, and in `not_isLorentzCovariant_aFour` pass `spectatorPlaneFour.toSpectatorSplitting` and `fun _ hq hT hu => gFour_self_ne_zero_of_spectator hq hT hu` directly to `eq_zero_of_isLorentzCovariant`. If a non-plane consumer is wanted later, add the structure then.
findings.issue: Parallel API: `apply_pTransverse_eq_zero` (175), `apply_p_eq_zero` (192), `apply_pTransverse_eq_zero_right` (201) and `apply_p_eq_zero_right` (209) state exactly the conclusions of `apply_pTransverse_eq_zero_of_spectatorPlane` (217), `apply_p_eq_zero_of_spectatorPlane` (224), `apply_pTransverse_eq_zero_right_of_spectatorPlane` (231) and `apply_p_eq_zero_right_of_spectatorPlane` (237), under a hypothesis bundle with no independent instance. Supporting scaffolding: `SpectatorPartners` (Tensors/Basic.lean:1150), `SpectatorPartners.self_ne_zero_of_spectator` (1158), `SpectatorPlane.spectatorPartners` (1175), `SpectatorPair.apply_smul_add_smul` (1126, used only there) and `Witness.spectatorPartners_kFour` (ParityOdd.lean:509).

findings.evidence: ParityOdd.lean:426 `aFour K := aOfBasis (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 4)) K`; 430-432 and 448-450 are single-term wrappers over the general declarations, each with one or two call sites in the same file.
findings.fix: Delete both and use the general lemmas at `Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 4)`: `rw [aOfBasis_eq_det, Module.Basis.det_apply]` in `aFour_kFour_apply`, and `parityOddAssumptions_aOfBasis gFour (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 4)) kFour` in `existsUnique_eq_smul_aFour` and `not_isLorentzCovariant_aFour`.
findings.issue: `Witness.aFour_eq_det` (430) and `Witness.parityOddAssumptions_aFour` (448) are defeq restatements of `aOfBasis_eq_det` (350) and `parityOddAssumptions_aOfBasis` (359) at `b := Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 4)` — their proof terms are `aOfBasis_eq_det ..` and `parityOddAssumptions_aOfBasis g (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 4)) K`.

summary: The parity-odd annihilation lemmas are proved twice, once under the new `SpectatorPartners` bundle and once under `SpectatorPlane`, and the only `SpectatorPartners` instance in the repo factors through a `SpectatorPlane`, so the partners family and its scaffolding are a parallel API with no consumer the plane family does not already cover. The witness also restates two general `aOfBasis` lemmas at `Pi.basisFun` up to defeq.
